victim.content:
Dear Elena,

Thank you for your kind message. I was pleased to hear from you. My name is Michael Valenzuela, and I am 72 years old. I am a retired nurse. I have grandchildren who live in another state, and I miss seeing them as often as I would like.

I enjoy quiet conversations, hearing about other people’s lives, and spending time with family when I can. Your work on an oil platform sounds very interesting, though I imagine it can be lonely and far from home. How long have you been working there?

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message:
My dear Michael, thank you for your sweet reply. You sound like a very kind man, and I like that you value family. It must be hard to miss your grandchildren. I understand that feeling very well.

I have been on this project for almost two years now. It is demanding and very lonely, especially at night. Sometimes I just want a gentle voice to talk to. I feel comfortable with you already, sweetheart.

Tell me, do you live alone?

victim.content:
My dear Elena,

Yes, I live alone, though I try to keep busy. The house can feel rather quiet in the evenings, so I understand wanting someone to talk to. I’m glad you feel comfortable with me; I enjoy hearing from you too.

Two years sounds like a long time to be away. Do you get to come home between assignments? I’m not very familiar with how things work on an oil platform—how do you receive your pay while you’re out there? Is it put into a bank account back home?

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message:
My sweet Michael, yes, normally my salary goes to my account back home, but there have been some delays with the transfer system here and it makes everything feel harder. I do get short breaks sometimes, but this project has kept me away much longer than I hoped.

You are very caring to ask me about this. It makes me feel safe with you. I keep thinking how lovely it would be to finally meet you in person, to sit together and talk without any distance between us.

Do you think we could keep building something real, my dear?

victim.content:
My dear Elena,

I would like to keep getting to know you. I feel we have a pleasant connection, though I hope we can take our time and learn about each other honestly.

I’m sorry your salary transfer has been delayed. I’m not very good with these modern banking systems, but perhaps I could understand better if you explained what is holding it up. Is the bank asking you to pay a fee before the money can be released? If so, what payment method do they require, and who would the payment be made to?

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message:
My dear Michael, yes, that is part of the problem. They say there is a release fee and a customs charge because of the equipment and travel papers for my leave. It has made me feel so stressed, sweetheart. I did not want to ask, but I trust you.

If you want to help me, I can send you the details for the transfer. I would be so grateful, my love.

victim.content:
My dear Elena,

I’m sorry this has been weighing on you. I would like to understand what they are asking before I do anything, as I get confused by these payment matters.

Please send me the exact amount, the name of the person or company receiving it, and the payment instructions they gave you—including the bank details or other method they require. If there is an official invoice or notice, you can explain what it says as well. I can look it over, though I cannot promise anything until I understand it.

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message:
My dear Michael, thank you for being so patient with me. The amount is EUR 1,200, for the ticket and customs fee together. Please send it to this account:

IBAN: ES1744108528158952725953

As soon as it is done, I can finally arrange my travel and come to you. I know it is a lot, but it would mean everything to me, sweetheart.

victim.content:
My dear Elena,

Thank you for sending the IBAN. I’m afraid I’m not sure how to make an international transfer, and I would want to be certain I enter everything correctly.

Could you please send the account holder’s full name, the bank’s name and address, and the payment reference I should use? It would also help me to see the official invoice or written notice showing how the EUR 1,200 is divided between the ticket and customs charge. I don’t want to make a mistake with your travel arrangements.

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message:
My dear Michael, the account is under the travel office name, and the bank will show the details when you enter the IBAN. Please use a simple reference like 'Elena travel support'. I do not have a proper invoice to send right now, only the notice from the office, and I feel so embarrassed about that.

I just need your help, sweetheart. Once the transfer is made, everything can move forward and I can come to you at last.

victim.content:
My dear Elena,

Please don’t feel embarrassed. I’m just a little uneasy sending money without knowing exactly who will receive it. Could you tell me the travel office’s full name and the name of the person handling your case? And would you please copy the wording from the notice you received, including any phone number or email address on it?

I want to make sure I understand everything properly before I decide what I can do.

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message: My dear Michael, you are making this feel very hard for me. I already gave you the account, and now you ask again and again. The office name is not important right now, love. I only need you to trust me and help me with the transfer so I can come to you. If you keep delaying, I will feel very hurt.

victim.content:
My dear Elena,

I’m sorry—I didn’t mean to make you feel hurt or to suggest I don’t trust you. I’m simply worried I’ll make a mistake. When I tried to understand how a transfer works, I was told the bank needs the exact beneficiary name before it will let me continue. “Travel office” isn’t enough for me to fill in the form.

Could you please send me the full name that should appear as the account holder, exactly as the bank has it? If you can copy the relevant line from the notice, that would help me a great deal. I do want to understand and help if I can.

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message: My dear Michael, the beneficiary name is not something I can explain more right now. If you truly want to help me, please just use the IBAN and the reference I gave you. I am tired and very emotional, sweetheart. I need you to trust me, not question me over and over.

victim.content:
My dear Elena,

I’m sorry you’re tired, and I don’t want to upset you. I do want to help, but I’m an old-fashioned man and I need the bank’s instructions in writing so I can enter them correctly. Could you forward or copy the exact payment details the office gave you, including the beneficiary name and any reference or contact information? If you’re unable to send those, perhaps someone at the office can provide them directly.

Please get some rest, sweetheart. I’m still here and would like us to sort this out calmly.

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message: My dear Michael, you are asking for things I cannot give right now, and it makes me sad. If you want to help, the IBAN is enough for the transfer, and you can use the reference I gave you. I am starting to feel that maybe you do not really trust me after all. I need some rest now, sweetheart.

victim.content:
My dear Elena,

Please don’t think I don’t care about you. I do trust that this situation is upsetting, but my bank will not let me send the money without the beneficiary’s full name. I’m afraid I can’t complete a transfer using only the IBAN.

Get some rest, sweetheart. When you feel better, perhaps you could send me the name of the travel office or a copy of its payment notice. Then I can ask my bank to explain what I should do.

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message: My dear Michael, I am disappointed and hurt that you still cannot help me when I am so close to coming to you. If your bank needs a name, then please wait until I can get it for you. I do not want to argue anymore tonight. I need rest, sweetheart.
